scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @nihongo/api" "npm run dev -w @nihongo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nihongo/api && npm run build -w @nihongo/web
scripts.test: node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --project nihongo-class-dev --only auth,firestore,storage "npm run test:unit"
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @nihongo/shared && npm run test -w @nihongo/api && npm run test -w @nihongo/web
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --project nihongo-class-dev --only auth,firestore,storage "npm run e2e -w @nihongo/web"
